final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ab.translink AS translink, t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.translink, s1.tradekind, s1.cnt, CASE WHEN s2.total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total END AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt), AVG(ratio) FROM s3 GROUP BY tradekind
